claim: A 9/11 Commission staff report says NYPD Detective Yuk H. Chin recovered Satam al-Suqami's passport from a passerby; the passerby left unidentified while debris fell from the South Tower, and Chin gave the passport to the FBI on September 11, 2001.

sources.label: 9/11 and Terrorist Travel, Staff Report of the National Commission on Terrorist Attacks Upon the United States (2004), p. 40 n.109
sources.quote: The passport was recovered by NYPD Detective Yuk H. Chin from a male passerby in a business suit, about 30 years old.

notes: Verified against printed pp. 22 and 40 n.109 in both official copies of the Commission staff report. The copies have identical extracted text. The claim reports only the staff report's recovery chain and makes no inference about where the passport was before it was recovered.
